'''Daven Tam''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he was to transport [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Balmorrans offworld and bring them to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] where they become [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. However, the Empire was aware of their whereabouts and sent a squad of troops and Sith to exterminate them. He tasked a Republic spacer to assist him in finding the Force-sensitives inside the Zaros research facility before the Imperials find them.
